caveats: Two fixed full-consumption fixtures at 1 GiB heap, with unchanged source caches.
Collected misses are cleared-slot encounters before key comparison, not extra same-key rematerializations.
Whole-JVM GC includes setup/warmup; concurrent-cycle durations overlap other work.
Ledger reservations, allocation, occupied metadata slots and retained payload are distinct measurements.

estimators.absolute: Median of six per-JVM medians, separately for each fixture and arm.
estimators.primary: Six same-round ratios of per-JVM medians of all five measured queries per fixture.
estimators.secondary: Post hoc sensitivity requested after the cohort completed, not prespecified in the frozen protocol. Change only the JVM inner time summary to the arithmetic mean of those same five samples; retain same six round pairs and outer median. Not a replacement estimator.

evidenceScope: Raw queries, owner records, claims/JVM/root/completion receipts and GC logs. No runner/analyzer summary values imported; validation.json hashed only. Runtime identities remain the separate frozen audit scope.
